questions.answer: The reference angle is $30^\circ$; in Quadrant II, sine is positive. $\sin(150^\circ)=\sin(30^\circ)=\dfrac{1}{2}$.
The reference angle is $60^\circ$; in Quadrant III, cosine is negative. $\cos(240^\circ)=-\cos(60^\circ)=-\dfrac{1}{2}$.
The reference angle is $60^\circ$; in Quadrant IV, tangent is negative. $\tan(300^\circ)=-\tan(60^\circ)=-\sqrt{3}$.
